telling CMY Edith Jacob absent in 1871

She was probably Edith’s first cousin, daughter of Rev.

George Augustus Seymour (1828/9-1909), Rector of Holy Trinity, Winchester, and Elizabeth (Noel) Seymour (d. 1868).
